title: Hub shared definitions
description: Hub shared definitions. IDs are project-prefixed, type-segmented, allocated once, and never reused or renumbered.

idref.description: A machine-resolvable reference to another entity by id. The audit FAILS on any dangling idref.

provenance.description: Who/when/which-commit produced or last changed this entity.

agent.description: Agent id that last mutated this entity.

created_by.description: Agent id that created this entity; stamped once by the fold from its first event and never rewritten. Anything that must reach the author (a reply to a decision, a stalled task's owner) reads this, never agent.

evidenceUri.description: A pointer to the real result: a commit, live operation, artifact, task receipt, or an explicitly invoked structural audit.
